rights.original_game: Original Arknights emblems, item/contract images and reference imagery remain the intellectual property of their respective Arknights rights holders, including Shanghai Hypergryph Network Technology Co., Ltd. and associated entities.
rights.redraw_status: The six hand-authored adaptations are project designs, not official Arknights emblems. Redrawing does not establish permission for underlying referenced material.
